source.title: Should I sell or disenchant timewarped gear?

quote: They changed this for gear that dropped with the current timewalking event, it's giving storm dust now.
notes: First-person Feb 5 2025 commenter identifies a timewalking item-VERSION/material gate: equipment from that event could disenchant into current TWW Storm Dust, whereas a separate Feb 4 commenter in the same thread reports some other timewarped gear yielding old expansion reagents; another distinguishes tracked variants and notes exceptions. The discussion identifies NO exact gear item ID or bonus, quantity, output quality rank, controlled disenchant cast count, skill/spec, Resourcefulness, patch build or per-cast histogram. The discussion is NOT evidence that every Timewalking item or specifically 224753/224756 yields TWW material. Historical-versus-current item versions must be checked in game before any DE eligibility, baseline probability or gold EV. Do not interpret the conditional observation as a measured output rate.
outputName: Storm Dust (rank and item ID unspecified by firsthand commenter)
inputName: Equipment dropped during a February 2025 Timewalking event; exact items, bonus/version and upgrade tracks unspecified
requires: Specific Timewalking reward version or event state can change disenchant material family (TWW Storm Dust versus old-expansion reagents); exact eligibility/build gate unverified and requires exact item-version verification
